BiblicalUsage: Jehiah was a doorkeeper for the ark of God, who stood with Obed-edom when the priests blew the trumpets before the ark. He is named once, in the procession that brought the ark to Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the doorkeeper's place is a place of honour, and Jehiah stood at the door when God came in.
